description:
Join de Buyer USA affiliate and referral program! We are a 200-year-old French company that designs and manufactures cooking and pastry equipment for professionals and dedicated home chefs.

We are known for our premium cookware and bakeware, specifically our carbon steel pans. People across the U.S. have been raving about our pans for their exceptional ability to naturally develop a nonstick coating, free from any chemicals, offering a healthier and more sustainable cooking experience.

Right now, we are featuring our Blue Carbon Steel line, which has recently seen an increase in popularity due to it's price point. If affiliates want to promote these featured products, they will be eligible for a 15% commission. Approved affiliates who wish to only promote other products will receive 10% commission on each sale.

Minimum amount of followers on main platform: 5,000
payout_period: Commissions are processed the first week of each month for the preceding calendar month.
categories: Home & Tools, Grocery & Food, Mom & Kids
term_and_condition:
Welcome to La Brigade de Buyer! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals who access or use the Affiliate Program as an affiliate partner. Throughout this document, “we,” “us,” and “merchant” refer to La Brigade de Buyer, and “you” or “affiliate” refers to the individual or entity participating in the Affiliate Program.

By participating in the Affiliate Program, you agree to use the Program in the manner specified in these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

  1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program registration.

  1. Affiliate Links, Coupons, and Promotion

Affiliate links are automatically generated through the Affiliate Program dashboard. You may also generate affiliate links for specific products or collections when available.

If a customer clicks on another affiliate’s referral link and later clicks on your referral link, the most recent eligible referral link may be credited according to the Program’s tracking settings.

Affiliates may or may not be assigned a coupon code. Any assigned coupon code, including usage details and restrictions, will be shown in your dashboard. If a customer clicks your affiliate link and also uses your assigned coupon code, you will not receive a double commission.

If you are not assigned a branded coupon code, you are not permitted to promote one.

Affiliates may promote La Brigade de Buyer through approved owned or organic channels, such as websites, blogs, email newsletters, social media posts, and other non-paid promotional channels.

Paid referral traffic is not allowed. This includes, but is not limited to, Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, paid search ads, shopping ads, display ads, paid social ads, sponsored placements, or any other paid traffic source used to drive visitors directly to our website or through an affiliate link.

Any orders or referrals generated through prohibited paid referral traffic will be automatically denied by UpPromote and will not be eligible for commission.

Repeated or consistent violation of this policy may result in removal from the Affiliate Program at our sole discretion.

  1. Commissions and Payment

When you refer an eligible customer who completes a purchase on our website, you may receive a commission based on the applicable commission structure.

Commission amounts are calculated based on the order value and do not include taxes, shipping costs, discounts, refunds, chargebacks, or other additional fees.

In order to receive commission payments, you must provide accurate payment details in your affiliate settings. The payment schedule will be communicated through the Affiliate Guide page or affiliate dashboard.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed and approved. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy, which gives us the right to review each referral order.

Commission status is displayed in the Commission tab. Paid commissions will be listed in the Payment tab.

Transactions that result in refunds, cancellations, chargebacks, fraudulent activity, or other ineligible activity will not be paid out.

  1. Marketing Tools

We may provide promotional materials such as banners, logos, product images, collection graphics, or other approved marketing assets through the Marketing Tools tab.

You may download these materials or use the provided HTML embed code to share them through approved affiliate channels.

Affiliates may not alter La Brigade de Buyer brand assets in a way that misrepresents the brand, its products, pricing, promotions, or availability.

  1. Network

If the Network tab is activated, affiliates may invite others to become downline affiliates.

If a downline affiliate refers an eligible order to the merchant’s shop, the upline affiliate may receive a network commission depending on the merchant’s settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share your network link. Any affiliate who clicks that link and signs up may become a downline affiliate.

  1. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track customers who click on your affiliate link. Customers must have cookies enabled in order for us to track referrals.

If a customer does not allow cookies, clears their cookies, uses privacy settings that block tracking, or otherwise prevents tracking, we may not be able to attribute the sale and commission may not be paid.

The cookie duration is listed on the Affiliate registration form or within the affiliate dashboard. The tracking period begins when a customer clicks an affiliate link or uses an eligible affiliate coupon code.

Within the cookie period, eligible orders placed by that customer on the merchant website may result in commissions to the affiliate, subject to the Program’s terms, tracking settings, and approval process.

  1. Removal from the Affiliate Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the Affiliate Program, they may do so by contacting info-usa@debuyer.com.

We also reserve the right to remove any affiliate from the Program at our sole discretion, including for violation of these Terms and Conditions, misuse of affiliate links or coupon codes, prohibited paid referral traffic, fraudulent activity, misleading promotion, or behavior that does not align with our brand standards.

  1. Questions and Support

We are very glad you have joined the La Brigade de Buyer Affiliate Program.

You may revisit these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions at any time. If you have any questions, please contact info-usa@debuyer.com for support.

Go forward and refer!
